correctness.rationale: Direct group multiplication yields a correct all-depth commutator identity. For each v the coprime averaging projection proves A=C_A(v)⊕(v−1)A and (v−1)|_(v−1)A is invertible. Conditioning on the right element and the left complement coordinate, a uniform left-kernel coordinate pushes forward uniformly onto (v−1)A at every depth k≥2; all probability, Fourier, Burnside and Engelizer formulas follow by exact algebra. The noncoprime D16 example directly contradicts unsound extension. A separately implemented group-law checker evaluated all ordered pairs in ten finite examples at three depths; 464790 exact group-word evaluations and 3884 conditional fibers, plus direct complex Fourier comparisons, all passed.

value.rationale: The word is a mathematically motivated invariant studied in current probabilistic group theory. The result classifies its whole measure on a broad natural class, exactly stabilizes all depths ≥2, yields harmonic/Fourier and Burnside interpretations, and sharply characterizes equality at the smallest possible probability. Non-Frobenius examples fall outside the closest known digraph theorem. These are structural facts beyond a routine numeric sample or the already-known subgroup property.
